title: Oral History
description: An audio or video oral history recording or community narrative. Profiles digital-representation (CIDOC-CRM E73 Information Object) and adds mandatory fields for interviewee, language, consent status and IIIF manifest, with optional schema.org AudioObject/VideoObject alignment for web-visible metadata.

interviewee.description: URI of the person interviewed or narrating (schema:interviewee). Must reference an ogc.heritage.actor record. Required.

language.description: BCP 47 language code of the recording, e.g. "mt", "en", "it" (crm:P72_has_language). Required.

consentStatus.description: Consent and access status of the recording, e.g. "consented — public access", "consented — restricted to researchers", "anonymised", "pending consent review" (dct:accessRights). Required for legal compliance.

iiifManifest.description: URI of an IIIF Presentation API 3 manifest for this recording, enabling playback and timed annotation in IIIF viewers (crm:P70i_is_documented_in). Required.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the recording file (dct:format), e.g. "audio/mp4", "audio/mpeg", "video/mp4". Required; must be an audio/* or video/* type.

rights.description: Licence or copyright statement (dct:rights), e.g. a Creative Commons URI or "All rights reserved — Heritage Malta". Required.

transcriptUri.description: URI of a text transcript of the recording (crm:P70i_is_documented_in).

duration.description: Duration of the recording in ISO 8601 duration format (schema:duration), e.g. "PT1H23M45S".

contributor.description: URI(s) of other persons or organisations who contributed to the recording (dct:contributor), e.g. interviewer, sound technician, transcriber.

theme.description: Thematic keywords or controlled-vocabulary terms describing the recording's subject matter (dct:subject), e.g. "domestic life", "World War II occupation", "garden traditions".

historicalPeriod.description: The historical period or date range addressed in the narrative (crm:P4_has_time-span), e.g. "1940–1945", "interwar period".
